emotional_tone: Authority, clarity, modern modernity, and trust. Feels like a premium, executive-level oversight tool rather than a generic tech platform.

headings.strategy: High contrast weights. Use font-black for hero/main headings and font-normal for section headers. Tracking-tighter for all sizes above 32px.

body.strategy: Sterile, highly legible mono-inspired body font to contrast the expressive headings.

mono.strategy: For data points, file names, and metric values.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for dashboard cards. The Bento Grid Protocol (Control Room mode) for the dashboard. Tight gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard widgets, ensuring every pixel is utilized with h-full.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800). No soft muddy shadows. Use sharp inner contrasts.

components.buttons: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary buttons are #002FA7 with pure white text.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI standard, customized with sharp radius and border-gray-300. Focus ring: ring-2 ring-[#002FA7].
components.chat_interface: Streaming response UI pattern. User messages right-aligned in subtle gray bubbles. AI responses left-aligned with no bubble (transparent background) but rich markdown text, clear citations, and embedded tables/charts. Input field auto-focused at bottom.
components.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for app navigation. Dark or light depending on theme, utilizing a 1px right border. Clean IBM Plex Sans links.
components.dashboard_charts: Recharts. Use Line charts for trends, Bar charts for comparisons. Avoid walls of charts; focus on a single North Star Metric in the top left quadrant.
components.tables: Dense, grid-border style. border-collapse. Data aligned left. Use IBM Plex Mono for numeric columns.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicitly set hover text colors. Hover states must be a lighter hue of active state.
motion_and_interactions.chat: Smooth staggered fade-in for AI message tokens. Subtle pulse for typing indicator.

media_and_assets.icons: @phosphor-icons/react for duotone, high-end look across the dashboard.

landing_hero_building.description: Modern educational building with glass facade, to be used in the landing page hero section.

landing_feature_building.description: Secondary modern school building for feature sections.

testimonial_teacher_1.description: Smiling teacher portrait for testimonials or persona representation.

abstract_data_background.description: Abstract geometric data background for the login page or file upload area.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Never use gray-on-gray for essential data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='upload-excel-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Tailwind config to include Cabinet Grotesk for sans and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Ensure the landing page features a clear CTA, high contrast typography, and uses the provided modern building image.
Implement a premium chat interface similar to Dust/ChatGPT with no chat bubbles for AI, but structured markdown and data tables.
Dashboard must follow the Control Room grid mode. Dense, compact, using Recharts for visual data.
Ensure a dark mode toggle is available, switching seamlessly between Stark White and Dark Charcoal (#0A0A0A) backgrounds.
